name: vibe-crypto
description: Research, backtest and paper trade crypto and stocks, and use your own broker accounts, from Claude.
long_description: Runs the Vibe Crypto MCP server on your computer with uv (87 tools: market data, backtests, paper runs, 19 broker and exchange connectors). Needs uv installed: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/. Your keys stay on your computer. Order tools are off unless you turn them on in the extension settings; live orders also need a mandate and pass the kill switch.

extra_packages.title: Python packages
extra_packages.description: Comma-separated packages added next to Vibe Crypto, for example keyring,alpaca-py for Alpaca. Keep keyring in the list.

enable_order_tools.title: Enable order tools
enable_order_tools.description: Lets Claude place and cancel orders. Paper profiles trade broker sandboxes; live profiles still need your mandate and pass the kill switch. Claude must ask before each order.
